subject: general
question: In August 2024, the Mukhyamantri Mahila Samman Yojana was launched by which of the following states?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Jharkhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mukhyamantri Mahila Samman Yojana** was launched in **August 2024** by the state of **Jharkhand__**.
 
• This scheme is aimed at **empowering women** across the state.
 
• It focuses on providing **financial assistance** and **support** to women to help them achieve **self-reliance**.
 
• The scheme includes various components such as **skill development**, **entrepreneurship training**, and **financial literacy programs**.
 
• It also emphasizes on **enhancing women's health** and **education** by providing necessary resources and support.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Odisha**__

 __
 
• Odisha is known for its **rich cultural heritage** and **historical landmarks** such as the **Konark Sun Temple** and **Jagannath Temple**.
 
• The state has also implemented several **women empowerment schemes** like the **Mamata Scheme** which provides **financial assistance to pregnant and lactating women**.
 
 
 
• **Bihar**__
 
 
• Bihar has a rich historical significance, as evidenced by ancient universities like **Nalanda** and **Vikramshila**.
 
• The state has launched initiatives like the **Mukhya Mantri Nari Shakti Yojana** for **women empowerment** and **self-employment**.
